methodology_other:
For this project we used PlanetScope 3m resolution imagery to assess road damage in Venezuela following the Earthquakes.

We asked 15 volunteers to categorise every one image on the Zooniverse platform. We asked volunteers to identify road blockages or bridge damage within the imagery.

We generated a consensus from the raw data, and visualised this as a point dataset. The markings were then compared to satellite imagery by an expert.

La Guaira, Districto Capital, Yaracuy and Carabobo Road Level Categorised: primary and secondary

To see more about the project, you can view the project [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/planetary-response-network-venezuela-earthquake-2026).
name: venezuela-earthquake-road-blockages
notes:
We have assessed primary and secondary roads for signs of road blockages in the *La Guaira, Districto Capital, Yaracuy and Carabobo* regions of Venezuela. 

The latest updated data, uses imagery dated  **15th August 2026**.

The data is held in a shapefile format using the WGS 84 EPSG: 4326 projection.

You can find the Planetary Response Network Venezeulan Earthquake 2026 project we ran [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/planetary-response-network-venezuela-earthquake-2026). This is crowd sourced data.
